lines.zh: 你好，我叫张明。你叫什么名字？
lines.en: Hello, I'm Zhang Ming. What's your name?
lines.pinyin: nǐ hǎo wǒ jiào zhāng míng nǐ jiào shénme míngzi
lines.speaker: A

lines.zh: 你好，我姓李，我的名字是李强。
lines.en: Hello, my surname is Li; my name is Li Qiang.
lines.pinyin: nǐ hǎo wǒ xìng lǐ wǒ de míngzi shì Lǐ Qiáng
lines.speaker: B

lines.zh: 很高兴认识你。你是学生吗？
lines.en: Very pleased to meet you. Are you a student?
lines.pinyin: hěn gāoxìng rènshi nǐ nǐ shì xuésheng ma
lines.speaker: A

lines.zh: 是的，我是大学三年级的学生。你呢？
lines.en: Yes, I'm a third-year university student. And you?
lines.pinyin: shì de wǒ shì dàxué sān niánjí de xuésheng nǐ ne
lines.speaker: B

lines.zh: 我在一家公司工作，已经两年了。
lines.en: I work at a company; it's been two years already.
lines.pinyin: wǒ zài yì jiā gōngsī gōngzuò yǐjīng liǎng nián le
lines.speaker: A

lines.en: Is your job busy?
lines.pinyin: nǐ de gōngzuò máng bù máng
lines.speaker: B

lines.en: Very busy, but I like it.
lines.pinyin: hěn máng kě shì wǒ xǐhuan
lines.speaker: A

lines.en: Can you speak English?
lines.pinyin: nǐ huì shuō Yīngyǔ ma
lines.speaker: B

lines.en: A little. I'm studying it.
lines.pinyin: huì yìdiǎnr wǒ zhèngzài xuéxí
lines.speaker: A

lines.zh: 太好了，以后我们可以一起练习。
lines.en: Great, we can practise together from now on.
lines.pinyin: tài hǎo le yǐ hòu wǒmen kěyǐ yìqǐ liànxí
lines.speaker: B

lines.zh: 好啊，这是我的电话号码。
lines.en: Sure, here's my phone number.
lines.pinyin: hǎo a zhè shì wǒ de diàn huà hàomǎ
lines.speaker: A

lines.zh: 谢谢，我明天给你打电话。
lines.en: Thanks, I'll call you tomorrow.
lines.pinyin: xièxie wǒ míngtiān gěi nǐ dǎ diànhuà
lines.speaker: B

lines.en: How many people are there in your family?
lines.pinyin: nǐ jiā yǒu jǐ kǒu rén
lines.speaker: A

lines.zh: 五口人：爸爸、妈妈、哥哥、妹妹和我。
lines.en: Five: dad, mum, my elder brother, my younger sister and me.
lines.pinyin: wǔ kǒu rén bàba māma gēge mèimei hé wǒ
lines.speaker: B

lines.en: What does your elder brother do?
lines.pinyin: nǐ gēge zuò shénme gōngzuò
lines.speaker: A

lines.en: He's a doctor and works at a hospital.
lines.pinyin: tā shì yīshēng zài yīyuàn shàngbān
lines.speaker: B

lines.en: How old is your younger sister?
lines.pinyin: nǐ mèimei duō dà le
lines.speaker: A

lines.zh: 她今年十二岁，还是小学生。
lines.en: She's twelve this year, still a primary pupil.
lines.pinyin: tā jīnnián shí èr suì háishì xiǎoxuéshēng
lines.speaker: B

lines.zh: 你爷爷奶奶跟你们住在一起吗？
lines.en: Do your grandparents live with you?
lines.pinyin: nǐ yéye nǎinai gēn nǐmen zhù zài yìqǐ ma
lines.speaker: A

lines.zh: 不，他们住在南方的一个小城市。
lines.en: No, they live in a small city in the south.
lines.pinyin: bù tāmen zhù zài nán fāng de yí ge xiǎo chéngshì
lines.speaker: B

lines.en: How often do you see each other?
lines.pinyin: nǐmen duō jiǔ jiàn yí cì miàn
lines.speaker: A

lines.zh: 一年两次，过节的时候回去。
lines.en: Twice a year, we go back at festival time.
lines.pinyin: yì nián liǎng cì guòjié de shíhou huí qù
lines.speaker: B

lines.zh: 你的爸爸妈妈身体好吗？
lines.en: Are your parents in good health?
lines.pinyin: nǐ de bàba māma shēntǐ hǎo ma
lines.speaker: A

lines.en: Very well, thank you for asking.
lines.pinyin: hěn hǎo xièxie nǐ guānxīn
lines.speaker: B

lines.en: Waiter, could we have the menu please?
lines.pinyin: fúwùyuán qǐng gěi wǒmen càidān
lines.speaker: A

lines.zh: 你想吃什么？这里的鱼很有名。
lines.en: What do you want to eat? The fish here is famous.
lines.pinyin: nǐ xiǎng chī shénme zhèli de yú hěn yǒumíng
lines.speaker: B

lines.zh: 我不太喜欢鱼，我想吃羊肉。
lines.en: I don't much like fish; I'd like mutton.
lines.pinyin: wǒ bú tài xǐhuan yú wǒ xiǎng chī yángròu
lines.speaker: A

lines.zh: 那我们要一个羊肉，一个青菜。
lines.en: Then let's have a mutton dish and a green vegetable.
lines.pinyin: nà wǒmen yào yí ge yángròu yí ge qīngcài
lines.speaker: B

lines.zh: 再来两碗米饭和一个汤。
lines.en: And two bowls of rice and a soup.
lines.pinyin: zài lái liǎng wǎn mǐfàn hé yí ge tāng
lines.speaker: A

lines.en: What will you drink? Beer or tea?
lines.pinyin: nǐ hē shénme píjiǔ háishì chá
lines.speaker: B

lines.zh: 我要一杯热茶，我不喝酒。
lines.en: I'll have a cup of hot tea; I don't drink alcohol.
lines.pinyin: wǒ yào yì bēi rè chá wǒ bù hē jiǔ
lines.speaker: A

lines.en: All right, I'll have a bottle of beer.
lines.pinyin: hǎo wǒ yào yì píng píjiǔ
lines.speaker: B

lines.en: Are these dishes enough?
lines.pinyin: zhè xiē cài gòu bú gòu
lines.speaker: A

lines.en: I think so; if not we'll order more.
lines.pinyin: wǒ juéde gòu le bú gòu zài diǎn
lines.speaker: B

lines.zh: 这个菜真好吃，也很新鲜。
lines.en: This dish is really tasty and very fresh.
lines.pinyin: zhè ge cài zhēn hǎochī yě hěn xīnxiān
lines.speaker: A

lines.en: Let's come here again next time.
lines.pinyin: xià cì wǒmen hái lái zhèr ba
lines.speaker: B

lines.en: Excuse me, how do I get to the train station?
lines.pinyin: qǐng wèn huǒchēzhàn zěnme zǒu
lines.speaker: A

lines.zh: 你一直向前走，然后向左边。
lines.en: Go straight ahead and then turn left.
lines.pinyin: nǐ yìzhí xiàng qián zǒu ránhòu xiàng zuǒbian
lines.speaker: B

lines.en: Is it far from here?
lines.pinyin: lí zhèr yuǎn ma
lines.speaker: A

lines.zh: 不太远，走十五分钟就到了。
lines.en: Not very far, fifteen minutes on foot.
lines.pinyin: bú tài yuǎn zǒu shí wǔ fēnzhōng jiù dào le
lines.speaker: B

lines.zh: 我也可以坐公共汽车吗？
lines.en: Can I take a bus as well?
lines.pinyin: wǒ yě kěyǐ zuò gōnggòngqìchē ma
lines.speaker: A

lines.en: Yes, take the number 10; it's three stops.
lines.pinyin: kěyǐ zuò shí lù sān zhàn jiù dào
lines.speaker: B

lines.en: Where's the bus stop?
lines.pinyin: chē zhàn zài nǎr
lines.speaker: A

lines.en: Right beside that bank.
lines.pinyin: jiù zài nà ge yínháng de pángbiān
lines.speaker: B

lines.en: I understand now, thank you very much.
lines.pinyin: wǒ míngbai le fēicháng xièxie nǐ
lines.speaker: A

lines.zh: 不客气。你要小心，路上车很多。
lines.en: You're welcome. Be careful, there's a lot of traffic.
lines.pinyin: búkèqi nǐ yào xiǎoxīn lù shàng chē hěn duō
lines.speaker: B

lines.en: All right, I'll pay attention.
lines.pinyin: hǎo de wǒ huì zhùyì de
lines.speaker: A

lines.en: Have a safe trip.
lines.pinyin: yílù píng'ān
lines.speaker: B

lines.zh: 这个周末你有什么打算？
lines.en: What are your plans this weekend?
lines.pinyin: zhè ge zhōumò nǐ yǒu shénme dǎsuàn
lines.speaker: A

lines.zh: 我打算去公园跑步，然后看电影。
lines.en: I plan to go running in the park, then see a film.
lines.pinyin: wǒ dǎsuàn qù gōngyuán pǎobù ránhòu kàn diànyǐng
lines.speaker: B

lines.en: Who are you going with?
lines.pinyin: gēn shéi yìqǐ qù
lines.speaker: A

lines.zh: 我的同事，他也喜欢运动。
lines.en: My colleague; he likes sport too.
lines.pinyin: wǒ de tóngshì tā yě xǐhuan yùndòng
lines.speaker: B

lines.zh: 我周末要打扫房间，还要洗衣服。
lines.en: At the weekend I have to clean my room and wash clothes.
lines.pinyin: wǒ zhōumò yào dǎsǎo fángjiān hái yào xǐ yīfu
lines.speaker: A

lines.en: Sounds busy.
lines.pinyin: tīng qǐlái hěn máng
lines.speaker: B

lines.zh: 是啊，可是做完以后很舒服。
lines.en: It is, but it feels good once it's done.
lines.pinyin: shì a kě shì zuò wán yǐ hòu hěn shūfu
lines.speaker: A

lines.zh: 晚上你有时间吗？我们可以聊天。
lines.en: Do you have time in the evening? We could chat.
lines.pinyin: wǎnshang nǐ yǒu shíjiān ma wǒmen kěyǐ liáotiān
lines.speaker: B

lines.zh: 有，晚上八点以后都可以。
lines.en: Yes, any time after eight.
lines.pinyin: yǒu wǎnshang bā diǎn yǐ hòu dōu kěyǐ
lines.speaker: A

lines.en: I'll ring you then.
lines.pinyin: nà wǒ gěi nǐ dǎ diànhuà
lines.speaker: B

lines.en: All right, don't forget.
lines.pinyin: hǎo bié wàng le
lines.speaker: A

lines.en: I definitely won't.
lines.pinyin: yídìng bú huì
lines.speaker: B

lines.en: What's the weather like today?
lines.pinyin: jīntiān tiānqì zěnmeyàng
lines.speaker: A

lines.zh: 早上是晴天，可是现在阴了。
lines.en: It was clear in the morning but it's cloudy now.
lines.pinyin: zǎoshang shì qíng tiān kě shì xiànzài yīn le
lines.speaker: B

lines.en: Will it rain?
lines.pinyin: huì xiàyǔ ma
lines.speaker: A

lines.en: Probably. Did you bring an umbrella?
lines.pinyin: kěnéng huì nǐ dài sǎn le ma
lines.speaker: B

lines.zh: 没有，我早上出门的时候忘了。
lines.en: No, I forgot when I went out this morning.
lines.pinyin: méiyǒu wǒ zǎoshang chū mén de shíhou wàng le
lines.speaker: A

lines.zh: 我这里有两把，给你一把。
lines.en: I have two here, take one.
lines.pinyin: wǒ zhèli yǒu liǎng bǎ gěi nǐ yì bǎ
lines.speaker: B

lines.en: Thank you so much.
lines.pinyin: tài xièxie nǐ le
lines.speaker: A

lines.zh: 不客气。冬天的时候这里还下雪。
lines.en: Not at all. In winter it even snows here.
lines.pinyin: búkèqi dōngtiān de shíhou zhèli hái xià xuě
lines.speaker: B

lines.en: Really? Snow is my favourite.
lines.pinyin: zhēn de ma wǒ zuì xǐhuan xuě
lines.speaker: A

lines.en: But it's very cold when the wind blows.
lines.pinyin: kě shì guāfēng de shíhou hěn lěng
lines.speaker: B

lines.zh: 没关系，我可以多穿衣服。
lines.en: That's fine, I can wear more clothes.
lines.pinyin: méi guānxi wǒ kěyǐ duō chuān yīfu
lines.speaker: A

lines.en: Then you should buy a thick one.
lines.pinyin: nà nǐ yào mǎi yí jiàn hòu de
lines.speaker: B

lines.zh: 你今天看起来不太舒服。
lines.en: You don't look very well today.
lines.pinyin: nǐ jīntiān kàn qǐlái bú tài shūfu
lines.speaker: A

lines.en: I have a bit of a cold and my head aches.
lines.pinyin: wǒ yǒudiǎnr gǎnmào tóu hěn téng
lines.speaker: B

lines.en: Do you have a fever?
lines.pinyin: nǐ fāshāo le ma
lines.speaker: A

lines.zh: 有一点儿，早上三十八度。
lines.en: A little, thirty-eight degrees this morning.
lines.pinyin: yǒu yìdiǎnr zǎoshang sān shí bā dù
lines.speaker: B

lines.zh: 你应该去医院检查一下。
lines.en: You should go to the hospital for a check-up.
lines.pinyin: nǐ yīnggāi qù yīyuàn jiǎnchá yíxià
lines.speaker: A

lines.en: I'll go this afternoon.
lines.pinyin: wǒ xiàwǔ jiù qù
lines.speaker: B

lines.zh: 医生可能会给你一些药。
lines.en: The doctor will probably give you some medicine.
lines.pinyin: yīshēng kěnéng huì gěi nǐ yìxiē yào
lines.speaker: A

lines.en: I hope I'll be better after taking it.
lines.pinyin: xīwàng chī le yào jiù huì hǎo
lines.speaker: B

lines.zh: 你要多休息，别工作太累。
lines.en: You should rest more and not tire yourself with work.
lines.pinyin: nǐ yào duō xiūxi bié gōngzuò tài lèi
lines.speaker: A

lines.en: Thanks for your concern.
lines.pinyin: xièxie nǐ guānxīn wǒ
lines.speaker: B

lines.zh: 我很担心你，有事给我打电话。
lines.en: I'm worried about you; call me if anything comes up.
lines.pinyin: wǒ hěn dānxīn nǐ yǒu shì gěi wǒ dǎ diànhuà
lines.speaker: A

lines.en: I will, don't worry.
lines.pinyin: wǒ huì de fàngxīn ba
lines.speaker: B

lines.zh: 我想买一件衬衫，你觉得哪个好？
lines.en: I want to buy a shirt; which do you think is good?
lines.pinyin: wǒ xiǎng mǎi yí jiàn chènshān nǐ juéde nǎ ge hǎo
lines.speaker: A

lines.en: That blue one is very nice.
lines.pinyin: lánsè de nà jiàn hěn piàoliang
lines.speaker: B

lines.en: How much is it?
lines.pinyin: duōshao qián
lines.speaker: A

lines.en: A hundred and eighty yuan, not too expensive.
lines.pinyin: yì bǎi bā shí kuài bú tài guì
lines.speaker: B

lines.en: May I try it on?
lines.pinyin: wǒ kěyǐ shì yíxià ma
lines.speaker: A

lines.zh: 当然可以，洗手间旁边就是。
lines.en: Of course, it's right by the toilets.
lines.pinyin: dāngrán kěyǐ xǐshǒujiān pángbiān jiù shì
lines.speaker: B

lines.zh: 有点儿小，有大一点儿的吗？
lines.en: It's a bit small; do you have a larger one?
lines.pinyin: yǒudiǎnr xiǎo yǒu dà yìdiǎnr de ma
lines.speaker: A

lines.en: Yes, I'll get it for you.
lines.pinyin: yǒu wǒ gěi nǐ ná
lines.speaker: B

lines.en: This one fits well, I'll take it.
lines.pinyin: zhè jiàn hěn héshì wǒ mǎi le
lines.speaker: A

lines.en: Card or cash?
lines.pinyin: nǐ yòng xìnyòngkǎ háishì gěi qián
lines.speaker: B

lines.en: Card, please.
lines.pinyin: wǒ yòng xìnyòngkǎ
lines.speaker: A

lines.en: All right, one moment please.
lines.pinyin: hǎo de qǐng děng yíxià
lines.speaker: B

lines.en: What time does our flight take off?
lines.pinyin: wǒmen de hángbān jǐ diǎn qǐfēi
lines.speaker: A

lines.en: Half past two in the afternoon; it's still early.
lines.pinyin: xiàwǔ liǎng diǎn bàn xiànzài hái zǎo
lines.speaker: B

lines.en: My suitcase is too heavy.
lines.pinyin: wǒ de xínglixiāng tài zhòng le
lines.speaker: A

lines.en: Let me help you carry it.
lines.pinyin: wǒ bāng nǐ ná ba
lines.speaker: B

lines.en: Thanks. Did you bring your passport?
lines.pinyin: xièxie nǐ dài hùzhào le ma
lines.speaker: A

lines.en: Yes, it's right here in my bag.
lines.pinyin: dài le jiù zài wǒ de bāo lǐ
lines.speaker: B

lines.zh: 机场很大，洗手间在哪儿？
lines.en: The airport is huge; where are the toilets?
lines.pinyin: jīchǎng hěn dà xǐshǒujiān zài nǎr
lines.speaker: A

lines.zh: 在前面右边，我们一起去。
lines.en: Ahead on the right; let's go together.
lines.pinyin: zài qiánmiàn yòubian wǒmen yìqǐ qù
lines.speaker: B

lines.zh: 我们到那边以后住哪儿？
lines.en: Where are we staying after we arrive?
lines.pinyin: wǒmen dào nà biān yǐ hòu zhù nǎr
lines.speaker: A

lines.zh: 我已经订了一个宾馆，离机场很近。
lines.en: I've already booked a hotel very close to the airport.
lines.pinyin: wǒ yǐjīng dìng le yí ge bīnguǎn lí jīchǎng hěn jìn
lines.speaker: B

lines.en: You've thought of everything.
lines.pinyin: nǐ xiǎng de zhēn zhōudào
lines.speaker: A

lines.zh: 飞机降落以后，我们先休息。
lines.en: After the plane lands we'll rest first.
lines.pinyin: fēijī jiàngluò yǐ hòu wǒmen xiān xiūxi
lines.speaker: B

lines.en: How long have you been studying Chinese?
lines.pinyin: nǐ xué Zhōngwén duō jiǔ le
lines.speaker: A

lines.zh: 一年半了，可是还是很难。
lines.en: A year and a half, but it's still hard.
lines.pinyin: yì nián bàn le kě shì háishì hěn nán
lines.speaker: B

lines.en: What's hardest?
lines.pinyin: nǎli zuì nán
lines.speaker: A

lines.en: Characters are hardest, and the tones.
lines.pinyin: hàn zì zuì nán hái yǒu shēngyīn
lines.speaker: B

lines.zh: 我觉得你的普通话说得很清楚。
lines.en: I think your Mandarin is very clear.
lines.pinyin: wǒ juéde nǐ de pǔtōnghuà shuō de hěn qīngchu
lines.speaker: A

lines.en: Thank you, I practise every day.
lines.pinyin: xièxie wǒ měitiān dōu liànxí
lines.speaker: B

lines.en: What method do you use?
lines.pinyin: nǐ yòng shénme bànfǎ
lines.speaker: A

lines.zh: 我看中文电视，也听中文歌。
lines.en: I watch Chinese TV and listen to Chinese songs.
lines.pinyin: wǒ kàn Zhōngwén diànshì yě tīng Zhōngwén gē
lines.speaker: B

lines.en: What about writing?
lines.pinyin: xiě zì ne
lines.speaker: A

lines.zh: 我在笔记本上写句子，一天写十个。
lines.en: I write sentences in a notebook, ten a day.
lines.pinyin: wǒ zài bǐjìběn shàng xiě jùzi yì tiān xiě shí ge
lines.speaker: B

lines.zh: 这个办法很好，我也要试试。
lines.en: That's a good method; I'll try it too.
lines.pinyin: zhè ge bànfǎ hěn hǎo wǒ yě yào shì shì
lines.speaker: A

lines.zh: 越练习越容易，你会发现的。
lines.en: The more you practise the easier it gets — you'll see.
lines.pinyin: yuè liànxí yuè róngyì nǐ huì fāxiàn de
lines.speaker: B

lines.en: I hear you've changed jobs?
lines.pinyin: tīng shuō nǐ huàn gōngzuò le
lines.speaker: A

lines.zh: 对，上个月我进了一家新公司。
lines.en: Yes, last month I joined a new company.
lines.pinyin: duì shàng ge yuè wǒ jìn le yì jiā xīn gōngsī
lines.speaker: B

lines.en: What do you do?
lines.pinyin: zuò shénme gōngzuò
lines.speaker: A

lines.zh: 我在办公室做电脑的工作。
lines.en: I do computer work in an office.
lines.pinyin: wǒ zài bàngōngshì zuò diànnǎo de gōngzuò
lines.speaker: B

lines.en: What's your manager like?
lines.pinyin: nǐ de jīnglǐ zěnmeyàng
lines.speaker: A

lines.zh: 他很认真，可是也很热情。
lines.en: He's very serious but also warm.
lines.pinyin: tā hěn rènzhēn kě shì yě hěn rèqíng
lines.speaker: B

lines.en: And your colleagues?
lines.pinyin: tóngshì men ne
lines.speaker: A

lines.zh: 都很好，我们经常一起吃午饭。
lines.en: All good; we often have lunch together.
